title: Four Different Decks
description: FR-604 promises each role sees only its permitted nav items — not just that the routes are blocked, but that the sidebar itself never dangles a link a role can't use. Walk all four roles and map exactly what each sees.
successCondition: Logging in as each of the four seeded roles and inspecting the left nav confirms: driver sees only Dashboard and Tracking; customer sees Dashboard, Book a shipment, Tracking, and Billing (not Fleet, Admin, or Reporting); dispatcher sees Dashboard, Book a shipment, Tracking, Fleet & scheduling, and Reporting (not Billing or Admin); admin sees all seven items including Admin console. Every role's set is checked by presence AND absence — a role must not see items outside its list.
hints: The full role-to-nav-item mapping lives in NAV_ITEMS inside apps/web/src/app/NavShell.tsx if you want to double-check the expected set before writing assertions.
Test absence with a "not present in the DOM" assertion, not just "not clicked" — a hidden-but-present link would still be a real accessibility issue.
